name: When should I contact a contractor versus handling interior storm cleanup myself?

mainEntity.name: When should I contact a contractor versus handling interior storm cleanup myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should reach out to an interior restoration contractor as soon as the storm passes and exterior breaches are secured. Securing immediate assistance allows a contractor to evaluate ruined drywall, subfloors, and framing early. A contractor who handles both structural repairs and fine finish work can document damage for your insurance adjuster, ensuring essential items like trim profile matching, subfloor stabilization, and ceiling blending are not overlooked in the initial claim estimate. Waiting too long risks mold growth and structural sagging.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional immediately if water soaked into drywall, ceilings, or subfloors, as hidden moisture causes structural rot and requires proper trade coordination.
